description: The payers Licium checks enrollment applications with: for each payer (and state), how Licium asks it (status_page, portal, phone, email), its public status pages and whether Licium reads each by itself, whether its status line takes automated calls, the day that way was last verified on the payer's own pages, how its status page, line and inbox answered in the last 28 days, the last day it answered, and the states where the payer-enrollment-records part has numbers (days to a decision, document requests). Free, no key. Figures from customers' applications appear only when at least 3 different customers stand behind them. Filter with state (two letters) and payer (part of a name).

payer.description: Part of a payer's name, e.g. 'aetna' or 'medicaid'.

state.description: Two-letter US state; rows for every state are included.

title: List the payers Licium checks
